docsQuote: In the initial stages of the protocol, the admin rights are owned by a simple multi signature wallet (Gnosis Safe) that is stood up behind a delayed multi signature wallet (custom-made by the dYdX team). The Gnosis Safe is a 2/3 wallet. ... At the time of launch, the delay on the delayed multi signature wallet is 1 day (86,400 seconds). ... To check the current delay (in case these docs ever go out of sync!) you can convert the secondsTimeLocked value from seconds to minutes/hours/days on Arbiscan (https://arbiscan.io/address/0xE412991Fb026df586C2f2F9EE06ACaD1A34f585B#readContract).

evidence.interpretation: Dolomite's official 'Admin Privileges' page (docs.dolomite.io/admin-privileges, HTTP 200, still live and linked from the docs nav) describes the protocol's control plane as: a 2/3 Gnosis Safe stood up behind a custom delayed multisig, where all admin transactions toward DolomiteMargin must wait the delayed multisig's secondsTimeLocked, documented as 1 day (86,400 seconds) at launch, and the docs explicitly tell readers to 'check the current delay' by reading secondsTimeLocked on the DelayedMultiSig at 0xE412991Fb026df586C2f2F9EE06ACaD1A34f585B (via the old DolomiteMargin at 0x6a76986201E1906eb8d887Bb4Ad74b55888617af, which the page links as 'DolomiteMargin'). Deterministic reads at pinned Arbitrum One block 524464076 (hash 0x18e9abe1..., timestamp 1794747021 = 2026-11-15 12:50:21 UTC) on two independent RPCs (gateway.tenderly.co/public/arbitrum and arbitrum.api.onfinality.io/public) show the CURRENT, documented 'Main margin contract' for Arbitrum One (0x6Bd780E7fDf01D77e4d475c821f1e7AE05409072, per docs.dolomite.io/smart-contract-addresses/core-immutable, 78 live markets) is NOT owned by the Safe/DelayedMultiSig stack at all: its owner() is 0xC2B66E247daE5Ee749Ae1d827190115F3653dE06 = DolomiteOwnerV2, Dolomite's own custom AccessControl owner contract (source: github.com/dolomite-exchange/dolomite-margin-modules/blob/master/packages/admin/contracts/DolomiteOwnerV2.sol; address confirmed in the project's official deployments.json under DolomiteOwnerV2[42161]). DolomiteOwnerV2 is not mentioned anywhere in docs.dolomite.io (searched llms.txt index and fetched pages; no DolomiteOwner page exists), and its own timelock secondsTimeLocked() reads 0x12c = 300 seconds (5 minutes) on both RPCs — 288x shorter than the 86,400 seconds the docs document, and below the Safe/DMS path actually still shows on the legacy deployment (86400s confirmed on-chain). DolomiteOwnerV2 additionally has an undocumented BYPASS_TIMELOCK_ROLE allowing certain functions to skip even the 300s delay. DolomiteOwnerV2's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by the documented 2/3 Safe 0xa75c21C5Be284122a87a37a76cc6c4dD3E55a1D4 (on-chain threshold 2, 3 owners — the Safe itself matches docs), but the Safe holds no other role; the EXECUTOR_ROLE / SECURITY_COUNCIL_ROLE / BYPASS_TIMELOCK_ROLE holders are not documented and not enumerable on-chain. Net: the effective control plane of the live DolomiteMargin is Safe(2/3) -> DolomiteOwnerV2(300s timelock + undocumented bypass role) -> DolomiteMargin, while the official risk disclosure still describes Safe(2/3) -> DelayedMultiSig(86,400s) -> DolomiteMargin and points users at the legacy DelayedMultiSig to 'verify' the delay.

evidence.docsCaveat: The admin-privileges page opens with 'In the initial stages of the protocol' and gives the launch-time delay, and its Arbiscan verification links point at the legacy (v1) DolomiteMargin/DelayedMultiSig addresses — which is precisely the mismatch: the page remains the protocol's only official control-plane risk disclosure, it instructs readers to verify the current delay via the DelayedMultiSig, and no page in docs.dolomite.io (llms.txt index fetched in full) mentions DolomiteOwnerV2, the 300-second delay, or the BYPASS_TIMELOCK_ROLE. The current core-immutable contract page lists 0x6Bd780E7 as the main margin contract without any admin disclosure. So the documented control plane (2/3 Safe behind 86,400s delayed multisig) does not match the observed control plane of the documented contract (owner = DolomiteOwnerV2, 300s delay). Whether the docs are stale or the parameter was lowered without disclosure, the published 86,400s does not match the observed 300s effective delay on the live margin owner.
